name: @marginfront/mcp
description: MCP server for MarginFront. Lets AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) record usage events, create and look up agents + signals, query revenue / cost / MRR analytics, manage customers + subscriptions + pricing plans, set per-customer cost and revenue watch alerts, read and manage internal code-spend caps, break down internal AI spend by repo or branch, read customer credit-pool balances, browse the supported-services catalog, generate and email invoices, manage customer portal sessions, and run the matter record (matters, routing rules, and the per-matter audit export) via plain English. 58 tools covering the full billing surface.
author: The MarginFront Authors
